guidance: At our plant in Varale, the Tyre Pyroly sis Oil began commercial sales in Q2, and we expect it to stabilize by Q3.
The recovered Carbon Black production starts in Q3, and we expect commercial sales to commence in Q4.
capex: Our 3,500 tonne per annum micronized rubber powder expansion is on track for commissioning in Q3 of FY27.
It will take our total MRP capacity to 20,000 tonnes per annum, making us the world's largest producer of MRP.
risks: This has got delayed by 3 to 4 months due to supply chain disruption and some of our equipment getting stuck in the Middle East and was not able to reach South Africa on time.
Profitability moderated from Q1 because of the start -up costs, geopolitical uncertainties and subsidiary performances.
focus: We remain focused on our Vision 2029, which is to achieve revenue of INR1,000 crores, revenue CAGR above 25% and profitability CAGR above 33%, EBITDA margins above 18% and ROCE above 30%.
I n the best case, it is targeting revenue of INR100 crores by FY27 by raising utilization at Kolkata, expanding nationally and growing its construction system business.
And for FY27, we are targeting revenue of around INR700 crores, EBITDA of INR126 crores and PAT of INR70 crores.
